ManagedContentType.description: RETIRED - nothing reads this. Authoring is in the GTM Content Manager. Mid-page structural copy for a GTM Offering's story pitch page (maStory): route steps, proof demo, capabilities cards, client profile, and BD/pitch-shift section. One record per

managedContentNodeTypes.helpText: One step per line, formatted as Label|Description, e.g. "Ingest|Every asset, read directly". The five steps are shown in order as a horizontal route diagram.
The paragraph inside the proof panel before the "See it work" button, e.g. "A snapshot of what the platform reads from an environment, automatically, on day one."

Demo dependency map shown after "See it work" fires. First line = root node name, remaining lines = dependency names, e.g. "APAC Onboarding
Welcome email
Shared data extension
Brand header"
managedContentNodeTypes.nodeLabel: Proof Panel: Demo Nodes (root first, then deps)

managedContentNodeTypes.helpText: One capability card per line, formatted as Icon|Title|Description|new, e.g. "In|Ingestion & inventory|Automatic, for Eloqua and SFMC.|false". Set the last segment to "true" to show the NEW badge.
The "Also in the toolkit" card below the capabilities grid. Supports bold/italic.
The large stat in the client profile section, e.g. "500–2,000+"
The description text next to the stat number.
The note line below the stat, e.g. "Today, this runs through us, in working sessions, not a self-serve portal..."
H2 for the BD/how-to-run section, e.g. "One story. Here's how to run it."
Opening paragraph of the BD section, e.g. "This is the pitch, the same one a client hears..."
One use-case card per line, formatted as Title|Description, e.g. "Presales|Run a prospect's export before the SOW..."
managedContentNodeTypes.nodeLabel: BD Section: Use Cases (Title|Description per line)

managedContentNodeTypes.helpText: Left column of the pitch-shift comparison (the "old" pitch). One chip per line.
managedContentNodeTypes.nodeLabel: Pitch Shift: Old Pitch Chips (one per line)

managedContentNodeTypes.helpText: Right column of the pitch-shift comparison (the new pitch). One chip per line.
managedContentNodeTypes.nodeLabel: Pitch Shift: New Pitch Chips (one per line)
